shopping/types/product.json.title: Product
shopping/types/product.json.description: A product in the catalog with variants and options.

id.description: Global ID (GID) uniquely identifying this product.

handle.description: URL-safe slug for SEO-friendly URLs (e.g., 'blue-runner-pro'). Use id for stable API references.

description.description: Product description in one or more formats.

categories.description: Product categories with optional taxonomy identifiers.

list_price_range.description: List price range before discounts (for strikethrough display).

media.description: Product media (images, videos, 3D models). First item is the featured media for listings.

variants.description: Purchasable variants of this product. First item is the featured variant for listings.

tags.description: Product tags for categorization and search.

metadata.description: Business-defined custom data extending the standard product model.

shopping/types/variant.json.title: Variant
shopping/types/variant.json.description: A purchasable variant of a product with specific option selections.

id.description: Global ID (GID) uniquely identifying this variant. Used as item.id in checkout.

sku.description: Business-assigned identifier for inventory and fulfillment.

type.description: Barcode standard. Well-known values: UPC, EAN, ISBN, GTIN, JAN.

barcodes.description: Industry-standard product identifiers for cross-reference and correlation.

description.description: Variant description in one or more formats.

categories.description: Variant categories with optional taxonomy identifiers.

price.description: Current selling price. Price is the amount per one whole `quantity_unit.unit` (for example, per lb or per hour); when `quantity_unit` is absent, it is per `each`. Line total is `price × quantity × 10^-scale`, computed and rounded once by the Business; `totals` remain authoritative.

quantity_unit.description: Sale basis this variant's `quantity` is denominated in. The default sale basis is `each`, whose machine identity is (`C62`, 0); `C62` is the UN/CEFACT Rec20 code for one/each. An absent catalog descriptor encodes that default. An `increment` advertises the ordering granularity in steps (for example, `scale` 2 with `increment` 25 sells in 0.25-unit multiples).

list_price.description: List price before discounts (for strikethrough display).

unit_price.description: Price per standard unit of measurement, for shelf-style comparison display. MAY be omitted when unit pricing does not apply.

options.description: Option values that define this variant (e.g., Color: Blue, Size: Large).

media.description: Variant media (images, videos, 3D models). First item is the featured media for listings.

tags.description: Variant tags for categorization and search.

metadata.description: Business-defined custom data extending the standard variant model.

seller.description: Optional seller context for this variant.

common/types/description.json.title: Description
common/types/description.json.description: Description content in one or more formats. At least one format must be provided.

html.description: HTML-formatted content. Security: Platforms MUST sanitize before rendering—strip scripts, event handlers, and untrusted elements. Treat all rich text as untrusted input.

shopping/types/category.json.title: Category
shopping/types/category.json.description: A product category with optional taxonomy identifier.

common/types/price_range.json.title: Price Range
common/types/price_range.json.description: A price range representing minimum and maximum values (e.g., a common example in retail shopping is when prices vary across product variants).

shopping/types/product_option.json.title: Product Option
shopping/types/product_option.json.description: A product option such as size, color, or material.

scale_min.description: Minimum value on the rating scale (e.g., 1 for 1-5 stars).

scale_max.description: Maximum value on the rating scale (e.g., 5 for 5-star).

count.description: Number of reviews contributing to the rating.

amount.description: Amount in ISO 4217 minor units. Use 0 for free items.

common/types/quantity_unit.json.title: Quantity Unit
common/types/quantity_unit.json.description: Sale-basis descriptor for quantities: the shared unit descriptor plus the Business's ordering policy. Its unit-descriptor machine identity remains (`unit`, effective `scale`); `display_text` and `increment` are excluded from identity and mismatch comparison.

increment.description: Ordering granularity, denominated in steps: the Business sells this item in integer multiples of `increment` steps. Its effective value is the provided value or 1. Advisory merchandising policy, not a representational bound: Platform-authored quantities SHOULD be integer multiples of the effective increment; the Business MAY accept, revise, or reject an off-increment request with a recoverable business outcome and MUST NOT silently reinterpret it. Business-authored quantities (checkout revisions, fulfillment events, adjustments) are bounded only by `scale`.

shopping/types/unit_price.json.title: Unit Price
shopping/types/unit_price.json.description: Price per standard unit of measurement. MAY be omitted when unit pricing does not apply. `unit_price.currency` MUST equal `price.currency`; the comparator MUST NOT perform currency conversion. `measure.unit` and `reference.unit` MUST be identical; cross-unit conversion is not permitted. Their scales MAY differ; each value represents `value × 10^-scale`.

amount.description: Unit price in ISO 4217 minor units. After satisfying the same-unit invariant, the Business MUST compute the comparator as `(price.amount / (measure.value × 10^-measure.scale)) × (reference.value × 10^-reference.scale)` and round it once to ISO 4217 minor units according to its pricing rules. The returned `unit_price.amount` is authoritative; the Platform MUST NOT recompute or substitute its own result.

measure.description: Product quantity in packaging/content (for example, a 750 mL bottle), distinct from `quantity_unit`, which defines the sale basis. Its integer `value` MUST be at least 1.

reference.description: Denominator for unit price display (for example, per 100 mL or per 1 kg). Its integer `value` MUST be at least 1.

shopping/types/availability.json.title: Availability
shopping/types/availability.json.description: Availability of an item: whether it can be obtained, and a qualifying status.

available.description: Whether this can be obtained. See status for fulfillment details.

status.description: Qualifies available with fulfillment state. Well-known values: `in_stock`, `backorder`, `preorder`, `out_of_stock`, `discontinued`.

shopping/types/selected_option.json.title: Selected Option
shopping/types/selected_option.json.description: A specific option selection on a variant (e.g., Size: Large).

id.description: Optional option value identifier from option_value.id. When present, the server SHOULD use it for matching; name and label remain required for display.

type.description: Type of link. Well-known values: `privacy_policy`, `terms_of_service`, `refund_policy`, `shipping_policy`, `faq`. Consumers SHOULD handle unknown values gracefully by displaying them using the `title` field or omitting the link.

url.description: The actual URL pointing to the content to be displayed.

title.description: Optional display text for the link. When provided, use this instead of generating from type.

shopping/types/option_value.json.title: Option Value
shopping/types/option_value.json.description: A selectable value for a product option.

id.description: Optional server-assigned identifier for this option value. When present in a selected_option, the server SHOULD use it for matching instead of label.

label.description: Display text for this option value (e.g., 'Small', 'Blue').

common/types/amount.json.title: Amount
common/types/amount.json.description: Monetary amount in the currency's minor unit as defined by ISO 4217. Refer to the currency's exponent to determine minor-to-major ratio (e.g., 2 for USD, 0 for JPY, 3 for KWD).

common/types/unit.json.title: Unit
common/types/unit.json.description: A reusable unit descriptor for quantities and measures. Its unit-descriptor machine identity is (`unit`, effective `scale`), where effective `scale` is the provided `scale` or 0; `display_text` is excluded.

unit.description: Stable machine identifier. The Business SHOULD use the exact UN/CEFACT Rec20 Common Code when one accurately identifies the unit. Otherwise, the Business MAY use a custom unit identifier and MUST use it consistently for the same unit. The Platform MUST treat an unrecognized identifier as opaque.

scale.description: One step equals `10^-scale` of `unit`. When `unit` is `C62`, `scale`, if present, MUST be 0. The maximum of 15 is derived from the interoperable integer range: at scale 16 a single whole unit (10^16 steps) is no longer representable, so larger scales cannot denominate one unit of their own basis. Businesses needing finer granularity use a smaller unit.

display_text.description: Required printable unit label provided by the Business. The Platform MUST use it when it does not recognize `unit`; for a recognized UN/CEFACT Rec 20 Common Code, the Platform MAY substitute its own localized label. It does not participate in unit identity or mismatch comparison.

common/types/measure.json.title: Measure
common/types/measure.json.description: A measure composed of an integer value and a unit descriptor. Its value is the integer count of `10^-scale` units of `unit`.
